research_question: Above an always-present BM25 plus ColSmol locator stack, can materializing a small set of Omni page representations recover most of the positive retrieval gain of a complete Omni tier?

retrieval.partial_semantics: Selected Omni pages retain their rank in the complete Omni Top-100 before RRF. This is a non-deployable global-rank oracle that isolates page-selection headroom.
retrieval.full_reference: Equal-weight RRF60 over BM25 Top-100, ColSmol Top-100, and complete Omni Top-100. Omni-only is reported separately.

selection_policies.random: Uniform corpus pages, 20 fixed repetitions; uses the full requested budget.
selection_policies.corpus_uniform: Evenly spaced pages in stable corpus order; uses the full requested budget.
selection_policies.physical_risk: Frozen qrel-free risk-cover order from OCR scarcity, entropy, and edge energy; uses the full requested budget.
selection_policies.omni_frequency_oracle: Future-workload Omni rank frequency; forbidden to a deployable method.
selection_policies.residual_label_oracle: Relevant Omni pages for queries missed by base Top-20 but hit by Omni Top-20; future qrels and ranks are forbidden.
selection_policies.global_label_rank_oracle: Relevant pages whose Omni rank improves over their base rank; future qrels and ranks are forbidden. Selects at most the budget and never fills with zero-utility pages.

cross_fit.history_policy: Select pages from base-miss/Omni-repair events observed in four folds, evaluate the frozen set on the held-out fold.

gain_recovery: (Q_partial - Q_base) / (Q_full_stack - Q_base); undefined when Full-stack absolute gain is below 0.005.

cost_accounting.semantics: Project selected page fraction onto measured full Omni build seconds and physical index bytes from the completed RTX 5090 runs. This is measured-total linear accounting, not per-page latency measurement.

gate.decision: If the Full stack has no positive gain, or a 5% future-information oracle cannot recover 70% of it and 70% of residual repairs, stop. Oracle GO only establishes headroom; a deployable method still requires history-only transfer above random/risk baselines.

information_boundary.warning: These domains already shaped the problem and provide an exploratory headroom audit, not a final held-out claim.
